decisions.reason: As a design-led decorative line very close to other burnout offerings, its market signal should be largely known by 2022 and management would likely prune it if it has not clearly earned its place in the range.

This transparent burnout fabric overlaps strongly with adjacent decorative options, so once uncertainty has resolved the firm is likely to withdraw it unless it showed distinctly better reorder potential.
Because it is another nearby burnout decorative fabric in a fashion-sensitive category, the option value of waiting is limited after several seasons and discontinuation becomes more likely.
A velour-like upholstery fabric fits the firm’s core upholstery business and can justify being kept longer because it broadens the stocked assortment with relatively low follow-on uncertainty.
The flame-retardant inbetween fabric serves a functional niche with repeat B2B demand, so keeping the option open is attractive when it complements the firm’s service-oriented core offer.

A polyester lining fabric with satin sheen is easier to replace and less distinctive for this firm, so management would be somewhat more inclined to reallocate space and attention to stronger core lines or new developments.
